limits: Texture timing excludes PLY loading and normal recovery, using the same cached cloud on both sides. It is not an end-to-end geometric fitting speedup.
Microbenchmarks were collected under shared-machine load; per-stage timings are indicative.
Independent normal chunks, face charts and benchmark runs parallelize; immutable cuboid selection remains sequential.
Default four-worker cap controls concurrency, not total RSS. Multiple benchmark processes multiply per-run memory use.
Existing fitting and quality limitations of the real elephant and L-shape corpus remain.
